```python
def _find_path(net, cap):
    # backward DFS from TT to SS on the shortest-path admissible graph
    dist = net.dist; pi = net.pi; to = net.g.to; cost = net.g.cost
    tt = net.TT; ss = net.SS
    # special handling per node type
    path = []

    stack = [tt]
    onpath = {tt}
    while stack:
        v = stack[-1]
        if v == ss:
            path.reverse(); return path
        i = _next_in_arc(net, cap, v, dead, onpath, path)
        if i >= 0:
            path.append(i)
            u = to[i ^ 1]
            stack.append(u); onpath.add(u)
        else:
            dead.add(v)
            stack.pop(); onpath.discard(v)
            if path: path.pop()
    return None
```
